Corollary
[A 3-dimensional solution has $\phi $-almost nonnegative curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0392 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-hamilton-ivey 1. appD:D.19\group Curvature Pinching

For a closed three-dimensional Ricci flow with $\lambda _{\min }(\operatorname {Rm})(\cdot ,0)\geq -1$, \[ \lambda _{\min }(\operatorname {Rm})\geq -\phi (R)R-3e^6, \] where $\phi (u)=\psi ^{-1}(u)/u$ for $u>3e^6$, $\phi (u)=0$ otherwise, and $\psi (x)=x(\log x-3)$. The function $\phi $ is bounded and decreasing on $[3e^6,\infty )$ and tends to zero at infinity.
